params.name: startHistoryId
params.description: Required. Returns history records after the specified `startHistoryId`. The supplied `startHistoryId` should be obtained from the `historyId` of a message, thread, or previous `list` response. History IDs increase chronologically but are not contiguous with random gaps in between valid IDs. Supplying an invalid or out of date `startHistoryId` typically returns an `HTTP 404` error code. A `historyId` is typically valid for at least a week, but in some rare circumstances may be valid for only a few hours. If you receive an `HTTP 404` error response, your application should perform a full sync. If you receive no `nextPageToken` in the response, there are no updates to retrieve and you can store the returned `historyId` for a future request.

tools.name: settings_create
tools.description: Adds a delegate with its verification status set directly to `accepted`, without sending any verification email. The delegate user must be a member of the same Google Workspace organization as the delegator user. Gmail imposes limitations on the number of delegates and delegators each user in a Google Workspace organization can have. These limits depend on your organization, but in general each user can have up to 25 delegates and up to 10 delegators. Note that a delegate user must be referred to by their primary email address, and not an email alias. Also note that when a new delegate is created, there may be up to a one minute delay before the new delegate is available for use. This method is only available to service account clients that have been delegated domain-wide authority. Required: userId. Optional: delegateEmail, verificationStatus. Returns the new Delegate.

tools.description: Updates language settings. If successful, the return object contains the `displayLanguage` that was saved for the user, which may differ from the value passed into the request. This is because the requested `displayLanguage` may not be directly supported by Gmail but have a close variant that is, and so the variant may be chosen and saved instead. Required: userId. Optional: displayLanguage. Returns the updated LanguageSettings.

params.name: userId
params.description: User's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: displayLanguage
params.description: The language to display Gmail in, formatted as an RFC 3066 Language Tag (for example `en-GB`, `fr` or `ja` for British English, French, or Japanese respectively). The set of languages supported by Gmail evolves over time, so please refer to the 'Language' dropdown in the Gmail settings for all available options, as described in the language settings help article. A table of sample values is also provided in the Managing Language Settings guide Not all Gmail clients can display the same set of languages. In the case that a user's display language is not available for use on a particular client, said client automatically chooses to display in the closest supported variant (or a reasonable default).

tools.name: settings_update-pop
tools.description: Updates POP settings. Required: userId. Optional: accessWindow, disposition. Returns the updated PopSettings.

params.name: userId
params.description: User's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: accessWindow
params.description: The range of messages which are accessible via POP.

params.name: disposition
params.description: The action that will be executed on a message after it has been fetched via POP.

tools.name: settings_update-vacation
tools.description: Updates vacation responder settings. Required: userId. Optional: enableAutoReply, endTime, responseBodyHtml (plus 5 more). Returns the updated VacationSettings.

params.name: userId
params.description: User's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: enableAutoReply
params.description: Flag that controls whether Gmail automatically replies to messages.

params.name: endTime
params.description: An optional end time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms). When this is specified, Gmail will automatically reply only to messages that it receives before the end time. If both `startTime` and `endTime` are specified, `startTime` must precede `endTime`.

params.name: responseBodyHtml
params.description: Response body in HTML format. Gmail will sanitize the HTML before storing it. If both `response_body_plain_text` and `response_body_html` are specified, `response_body_html` will be used.

params.name: responseBodyPlainText
params.description: Response body in plain text format. If both `response_body_plain_text` and `response_body_html` are specified, `response_body_html` will be used.

params.name: responseSubject
params.description: Optional text to prepend to the subject line in vacation responses. In order to enable auto-replies, either the response subject or the response body must be nonempty.

params.name: restrictToContacts
params.description: Flag that determines whether responses are sent to recipients who are not in the user's list of contacts.

params.name: restrictToDomain
params.description: Flag that determines whether responses are sent to recipients who are outside of the user's domain. This feature is only available for Google Workspace users.

params.name: startTime
params.description: An optional start time for sending auto-replies (epoch ms). When this is specified, Gmail will automatically reply only to messages that it receives after the start time. If both `startTime` and `endTime` are specified, `startTime` must precede `endTime`.

tools.name: settings_verify
tools.description: Sends a verification email to the specified send-as alias address. The verification status must be `pending`. This method is only available to service account clients that have been delegated domain-wide authority. Required: userId, sendAsEmail.

params.name: userId
params.description: User's email address. The special value 'me' can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: sendAsEmail
params.description: The send-as alias to be verified.

tools.name: stop_gmail_users_stop
tools.description: Stop receiving push notifications for the given user mailbox. Required: userId.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

tools.name: threads_delete
tools.description: Immediately and permanently deletes the specified thread. Any messages that belong to the thread are also deleted. This operation cannot be undone. Prefer `threads.trash` instead. Required: userId, id. Destructive.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the Thread to delete.

tools.name: threads_get
tools.description: Gets the specified thread. Required: userId, id. Optional: format, metadataHeaders. Returns array of Message.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the thread to retrieve.

params.name: format
params.description: The format to return the messages in.

params.name: metadataHeaders
params.description: When given and format is METADATA, only include headers specified.

tools.name: threads_list
tools.description: Lists the threads in the user's mailbox. Required: userId. Optional: includeSpamTrash, labelIds, maxResults (plus 2 more). Returns array of Thread.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: includeSpamTrash
params.description: Include threads from `SPAM` and `TRASH` in the results.

params.name: labelIds
params.description: Only return threads with labels that match all of the specified label IDs.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of threads to return. This field defaults to 100. The maximum allowed value for this field is 500.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Page token to retrieve a specific page of results in the list.

params.name: q
params.description: Only return threads matching the specified query. Supports the same query format as the Gmail search box. For example, `'from:someuser@example.com rfc822msgid: is:unread'`. Parameter cannot be used when accessing the api using the gmail.metadata scope.

tools.name: threads_modify_threads
tools.description: Modifies the labels applied to the thread. This applies to all messages in the thread. Required: userId, id. Optional: addLabelIds, removeLabelIds. Returns array of Message.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the thread to modify.

params.name: addLabelIds
params.description: A list of IDs of labels to add to this thread. You can add up to 100 labels with each update.

params.name: removeLabelIds
params.description: A list of IDs of labels to remove from this thread. You can remove up to 100 labels with each update.

tools.name: threads_trash_threads
tools.description: Moves the specified thread to the trash. Any messages that belong to the thread are also moved to the trash. Required: userId, id. Returns array of Message.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the thread to Trash.

tools.name: threads_untrash_threads
tools.description: Removes the specified thread from the trash. Any messages that belong to the thread are also removed from the trash. Required: userId, id. Returns array of Message.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the thread to remove from Trash.

tools.name: users_profile_get-profile
tools.description: Gets the current user's Gmail profile. Required: userId. Returns the Profile.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

tools.name: watch_gmail_users_watch
tools.description: Set up or update a push notification watch on the given user mailbox. Required: userId. Optional: labelFilterAction, labelIds, topicName. Returns the new WatchResponse.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

params.name: labelFilterAction
params.description: Filtering behavior of labelIds list specified.

params.name: labelIds
params.description: List of label_ids to restrict notifications about. By default, if unspecified, all changes are pushed out. If specified then dictates which labels are required for a push notification to be generated.

params.name: topicName
params.description: A fully qualified Google Cloud Pub/Sub API topic name to publish the events to. This topic name **must** already exist in Cloud Pub/Sub and you **must** have already granted gmail 'publish' permission on it. For example, 'projects/my-project-identifier/topics/my-topic-name' (using the Cloud Pub/Sub 'v1' topic naming format). Note that the 'my-project-identifier' portion must exactly match your Google developer project id (the one executing this watch request).
